# Madhan Mohan Reddy Peram

Developer based in Cuddapah, Andhra Pradesh, India.

## Summary

Madhan Mohan Reddy Peram is a developer based in Cuddapah, Andhra Pradesh, India, who builds scalable web applications, enterprise SaaS platforms, and AI-driven automation workflows. He specializes in React, Node.js, TypeScript, and the MERN stack, with hands-on experience in cloud deployment (Azure, Vercel), CI/CD pipelines, and agentic AI orchestration.

## Current Work

Madhan works at ShepherEd, building an enterprise college ERP and SaaS platform. He uses multi-agent AI orchestration to accelerate development — deploying specialized sub-agents to generate, validate, and iterate through codebases while maintaining full ownership of architecture, security, and production standards.

## Experience

- SDE Intern at CodeSizzler (Apr 2024 — Nov 2024): Built responsive frontend features for the HackersDock LMS, managed cloud hosting via Azure App Services, and engineered automated CI/CD workflows using Azure Pipelines.

## Projects

- EcoVate: Full-stack MERN application with authentication, form handling, and end-to-end production deployment. https://ecovate-global.vercel.app/
- Personal Portfolio: Cinematic dark-themed portfolio with WebGL particles, GSAP scroll storytelling, and editorial typography. https://vishnurohithb.dev
- Email-Based Calendar Automation: AI workflow using n8n and Gemini AI that extracts event details from emails and automatically creates Google Calendar events.

## Tech Stack

Frontend: React, Next.js, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, TanStack Query
Backend: Node.js, Express.js, Prisma, Zod, JWT
Database: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Supabase, Redis, Neon
Cloud & DevOps: Azure, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Vercel, CI/CD
Testing: Playwright, Vitest, Supertest, Postman
